messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning the lockfile bump + vendor sync for the release cut tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need owners to confirm submodule updates and any breaking transitive deps.
Sam: I will scan `go.sum` and the gateway deps today. If anything pops, I’ll post a short PR.
Maria: FYI I patched the python reqs for the metrics exporter; tests pass locally but wheel version needs bumping in the build. I can open a PR in ~30m.
Ryan: I can take the infra-submodule merge (repo: infra/shims). Will do a local dry-run. Can someone trigger the vendor CI once I push?
Alex: thanks — @Ryan please tag @Sam for the gateway change if you touch the shared proto. Also nudge ops for a quick smoke.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI job queued: `vendor-sync-ci` (#921) — estimated runtime ~12m.
Sam: re: transitive, I noticed grpc v1.54 -> v1.56 in one of the patches; appears to be minor but I’ll run the stressjob.
Maria: opened PR 438: "pyreqs: bump exporter wheel + lockfile regen" — includes a short test matrix. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pyreqs/pull/438
Alex: changelog nudge: anyone who made a user-visible change, please drop a 1-line entry in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased". We want to avoid last-minute edits during the cut.
Ryan: pushed infra-submodule branch `release-lock-bump/infra` -> opened PR 129. CI started. If green I'll merge and then ping here.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder — release cutoff in 14h 20m. Please avoid non-emergency merges after cutoff.
Sam: running `stress-test --suite gateway --concurrency 200` now, will paste results.
Maria: quick note: packaging change requires bumping the build matrix to include python 3.11. I added it to the PR.
Alex: checklist for merge signal: 1) all PRs linked to the release issue; 2) vendor CI green; 3) changelog entries done; 4) submodules merged; 5) smoke on staging. Reply here when you have all done.
Ryan: vendor CI green ✅ — merging in 2m.
Sam: stress results look fine, no latency regressions in the 30m window.
Maria: PR 438 merged. Will watch build artifacts.
Alex: merged infra PR and verified submodule pointers. Once artifacts from Maria are available, we set merge signal.
Maria: artifact uploaded: `exporter-1.2.4-py3-none.whl` — sha256: abc123...
Alex: ok team — final merge signal: proceeding with lockfile bump + vendor sync now. I’ll update the release issue and drop the RFC note.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started job `vendor-cutover` (id: 2026) — logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/2026
Sam: thanks all — will monitor post-cut perf and call out anything unusual.
Ryan: leaving a quick note: if you need to rollback the vendor sync, revert commit `b7c9e2f` on vendor/ with `git revert` and re-run `vendor-sync-ci`.
Alex: appreciate the fast turnaround. If we see any user-impacting regressions, we’ll open an emergency patch. Otherwise we’re good for tomorrow's release. :thumbsup:
